sources: Pew Research Center (5 March 2026), 25-country survey on morality, fielded Jan–May 2025: 'married people having an affair' morally unacceptable – Japan 65 %, South Korea 83 %.

Japan Family Planning Association (JFPA), survey on the lifestyles and attitudes of men and women, Sept–Oct 2023: 3,000 randomly selected people aged 16–49 (response rate 26.6 %); 'nearly half' of married respondents sexless (no intercourse for a month or more), via Japan Times 18 March 2024. 2016 wave: 47.2 % (nippon.com).

Cliché 3: widely repeated in articles (e.g. GaijinPot 'What is cheating culture in Japan really like?') without a named survey, year or sample; no representative survey found (checked 18.11.2026) -> 'no data'.
